sessions.name: Workshop | Breathwork: Somatic Breath
sessions.description:
Somatic Breath is a powerful breathing practice that focuses on releasing trauma by gently unwinding the acute and chronic tensions held in the body. Over time, chronic patterns of tension dampen life force, suppress emotional expression, alter perception, compromise movement, and eventually lead to disease. The focus of this modality is on completing the interrupted fight-and-flight responses stored deep within our nervous system and cellular memory.

In this workshop, we will explore self-help techniques by actively participating in our own healing process. Using conscious, connected breathing, movement, vocal expression, and self-applied touch, we support the body in releasing stored tension. Rather than focusing on the problem, we learn to follow the expressions of health.

By learning to monitor our own levels of activation, we take charge of our healing. We deepen our experience by connecting with the felt sense, using it to self-regulate the nervous system and attune to the subtle ways the body lets go.

The body can only release when it is ready. We never over-activate or force the process. This approach is safe and gentle, promoting a deep connection with ourselves in an open and loving way. We surrender the mind to the body’s innate intelligence.

sessions.name: Sound Healing | Gong Yoga Nidra
sessions.description:
Gong Yoga Nidra, or yogic sleep, combines guided awareness with the deep vibrations of the Gong to create profound relaxation and heightened awareness. It can help reset the nervous system, release habitual patterns, integrate change, and support healing.

In this 75-minute session, we will move through guided physical sensations, breath, and focused attention, allowing the body and mind to enter a deeply relaxed and receptive state.

sessions.name: Sound Healing | Tibetan Sound Healing
sessions.description:
Imagine lying down, your body cradled by the earth, as the ancient, resonant tones of Tibetan singing bowls wash over you. This is not merely a listening experience; it is a deep, cellular immersion. Using the profound principles of traditional Tibetan sound healing, we invite you to journey inward, where the vibrations work on multiple layers of your being—physical, mental, and energetic.

The soothing vibrations, rich with harmonic overtones, resonate through every cell, every tissue, and every subtle channel of your body. This is a therapeutic process that bypasses the analytical mind, speaking directly to the body's innate wisdom. You will feel tension melt away, stress dissolve, and a profound sense of inner peace begin to emerge.

This is a practice of conscious choice. In this sacred space, you actively choose:
• Stillness over rush: Allowing the vibrations to slow your racing thoughts and anchor you in the present moment.
• Gratitude over worry: Creating a shift in your emotional frequency, opening your heart to peace and appreciation.
• Presence over distraction: Turning your awareness inward, away from the noise of the outside world, and connecting with your truest self.
